triage_answers.decision: No c02 row cites a layout mark in boundary_evidence_refs, and none names a WEB paragraph or a chapter division. Every c02 row names an RP pilcrow in boundary_rationale, and each named pilcrow (3:10, 3:16, 3:18, 4:6, 4:14) is present in pmarks. Five rows state location only: W1-009 (1Cor.3.5-1Cor.3.9, the 3:10 pilcrow 'stands where'), W1-010 (1Cor.3.10-1Cor.3.15, 'begins under' and 'coincides with'), W1-012 (1Cor.3.18-1Cor.3.23, '3:18 carries a pilcrow'), W1-013 (1Cor.4.1-1Cor.4.5, 'falls at that turn'), W1-015 (1Cor.4.14-1Cor.4.21, 'coincides with this onset'). Two rows come nearest to crediting a mark with opening and closing a seam: W1-011 boundary_rationale (1Cor.3.16-1Cor.3.17), 'the onset and the close of this short unit', and W1-014 boundary_rationale (1Cor.4.6-1Cor.4.13), 'the onset and the close seam'. In both the seam is argued on content (the temple frame; the vocative meta-statement and the change of tone at 4:14), so the marks inform and do not decide. A wording such as 'coincides with' would remove the reading that the mark supports the seam. Asked, not ruled.
